## OPERATOR DECISION (2026-08-24) — promote to epic; decompose

Promoting this story to an **epic**. The escalation established two distinct problems with very
different risk profiles, so they become separate child slices, with an ADR gating the new-security
work:

- **Completion-side reuse is ALREADY identity-scoped by construction** (`verify_opcert_record`
  certifies only when `record.principal == own_principal` AND the DSSE signature verifies under this
  env's own key). So that half is **documentation + explicit test coverage**, not a trust-model
  change — UNLESS we want a different identity notion (key-fingerprint vs `env_id`/principal). That
  notion is one of the ADR's open questions.
- **Code-review attestation reuse is genuinely new security infrastructure** (no code-review op-cert
  kind exists; no authenticated diff/ref material fingerprint exists; `review-code` is diff-oriented
  not ticket-oriented; and whether a reused attestation may satisfy the Gerrit `LLM-Review +1` merge
  vote is an unsettled ADR 0013/0020 trust-boundary question). This must be settled by ADR before
  any implementation.

Decomposing into the child slices below. No trust-boundary decision is made here — that is the
ADR's job.
